mechanism: Treat any linear indicator as a digital filter: feed a unit impulse through it to recover the kernel (impulse response up to 1024 taps), then SpecAnalyzer converts the kernel to a frequency/period response so LPF/HPF/band-pass/band-stop cutoffs, transition-band slope (dB/octave), outband rejection, and acceptance-band ripple become measurable sensor parameters.
data_needed: Impulse.mq5 single-impulse series; chart indicator handle via IndicatorParameters+IndicatorCreate; SpecAnalyzer/SAInpData; frequency grid pitch 1/1024.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD chart demos; SMA(16), EMA(16), Universal digital filter LPF/HPF/band-pass; bar-period units (Nyquist period=2).
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an objective frequency-domain fingerprint of any MA/filter stack instead of visual chart comparison—usable to pick which period bands a sensor actually passes.
quote: We should admit that an indicator is a digital filter. ... Impulse response is a filter's response to a single impulse. The filters can be of IIR (infinite impulse response, for example, Exponential Moving Average, EMA) and FIR (finite impulse response, for example, Simple Moving Average, SMA) types.

mechanism: Decompose price as sum of discrete sine waves; apply band-pass with cutoffs 1/T_hi and 1/T_lo (e.g. keep 30–50 bar periods) or band-stop to reject that band, so only selected cycle-length components remain as the sensed state.
data_needed: Discrete price/OHLC series; designed FIR/IIR kernels with stated cutoffs; optional SpecAnalyzer to verify passband.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Synthetic 10–70 bar period sums; EURUSD with Universal digital filter band-pass example.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit multi-scale cycle-band sensor: MIS can gate regime logic on which bar-period band currently dominates after filtration.
quote: To leave the periods of 30, 40 and 50, we need a bandwidth filter (BF) with cut-off frequencies of 1/25 and 1/55 (1/bars).

mechanism: Train RandomUniformForest on oscillator matrix vs ZigZag sign; rank features by global info-gain, then re-rank by interaction (1st/2nd order co-occurrence in terminal nodes), class-conditional importance, and partial dependence separability; keep interaction-aware top-k (article: cci,cmo,slowD,oscK,signal,tr,ADX,chv,atr,ar) which cut test error ~20%→17.5%.
data_needed: Cleaned predictor matrix + balanced Class∈{-1,1}; ruf with ntree≈300; importance(..., maxInteractions=3); partialDependenceOverResponses.

why_new_for_mis: MIS feature gate that prefers interaction+class-local importance over naive global scores—e.g. true-range jumps from last to 6th via interactions.
quote: Importance = contribution + interaction, where contribution is the influence of a variable (in respect to influencing all) on prediction errors, and interaction is an impact on other variables.
